This is the case since:
- Solids struggle to move on their own let alone rotate
- Liquids can vibrate rotate etc. but they struggle to fully encapsulate some container they are stored in, due to gravitational pressures
- Gas can fully encapsulate their container and can move in all directions, rarely hitting each other, $\rightarrow$ they have full translation 
###### Gas Mixtures ($\ce V_T = V_a = V_b$)
- All gas components in a container share the same volume, as there is minimal attraction forces between them and so much space between them that their differences are **negligible**
### Kinetic Molecular Theory (KMT)
###### 1. The volume of initial gas molecules is negligible compared to the volume of a container holding the gas
- This is the case because of how far apart they are, where there is almost no attraction
###### 2. There is neither an Attractive or Repulsive force between the gas molecules.
- Because, as stated in 1. their attraction is negligible
###### 3. Gas molecules have high translation energy $\rightarrow$ They move randomly in all directions in a straight line
- This is because they are in constant random motion
###### 4. Gas molecules will eventually collide with each other and will result in a perfectly elastic collision (no loss of kinetic energy)
- This is because the molecules have minimal interactions with each other (no sticking, deforming or bonding) meaning they simply bounce off each other
###### 5. The average Kinetic Energy of gas molecules is directly related to temperature
- This is because as temperature increases, energy in the system increases
###### A few takeaways
- Assume Ideal Gas Law (ALL KMT properties will have to apply in this unit)
### Defining the system
- A system is everything part of an analysis. It defines what is allowed to be exchanged in boundary of analysis.
- There exists 3 Key Types of systems:

- A **Open** system is one where outside matter AND energy can come
- A **Closed** system is one where outside matter may not come in but ENERGY can
- A **Isolated** system is one where outside matter and energy $\ne$ come in
